phones.notes: ITU/INCM confirms country code +258 and public mobile allocations including 83, 87 and the new 88 NDC. Broad 8-leading generation was replaced with directly sourced NDCs only.

locations.notes: UPU example confirms Mozambique's four-digit postcode structure and address ordering. City/street samples remain representative review data; postalPrefixes are generator prefixes, not complete postcodes.

source.title: PRADO Mozambique passport and identity document country listing

national_identity_card_number.notes: Public sources confirm Mozambique identity/travel document context but no official public BI number grammar, checksum or semantic digit rule was confirmed. BI is a generator marker, not a claimed literal prefix.

source.title: PRADO Mozambique ordinary passport document entries

passport.notes: PRADO confirms Mozambique ordinary passport entries. The public listing does not confirm passport-number grammar.

tax_identification_number_nuit.label: Taxpayer Single Identification Number (NUIT)
tax_identification_number_nuit.notes: Official AT FAQ confirms NUIT is a nine-digit taxpayer identification number. No checksum implementation is generated because the public source does not document an algorithm.
